New here?

Relax. Dress how you want. Be yourself. You are welcome, just as you are.

Worship rooted in Scripture

At Bethlehem, the Bible comes first. Our preaching is grounded in Scripture, and our worship carries on a tradition of singing the hymns of faith together — because in many ways, our congregation is our choir.

If you're looking for a church home that holds fast to God's Word and still loves to sing the old songs, you'll find it here.

We are the church

Bethlehem is a warm and authentic community — one that leaves the world better than we found it. From packing nearly 40,000 meals through Food for Kidz in 2025 to hosting neighbors at Trunk or Treat, service isn't something we talk about. It's something we do.

See how we serve →

Giving back to God

“Give, and it will be given to you.” — Luke 6:38

Through faith in Christ we are transformed into generous people. Regular giving helps keep our church alive and reminds us to always put God first.
